Navratri 2026 Dates and Zodiac Sign Connections

The year 2026 will see Navratri celebrations beginning on October 13th, with the festival concluding on October 22nd. Specific dates for Durga Ashtami and Maha Navami have been provided, along with the date for Dussehra. The festival is also linked to different forms of Maa Durga corresponding to zodiac signs.
